note: Sense: numerical network host identifier. JMdict 2159840 s0 gloss IP address, field comp. Acronym IP capitalised per reviewer feedback and validator allowance.

en.sense_definition: A unique numerical identifier assigned to each device connected to a computer network utilizing the Internet Protocol.

falsification.example_en: The network administrator assigned a static IP address to each web server.
falsification.example_ja: ネットワーク管理者は各ウェブサーバーに静的なＩＰアドレスを割り当てた。
falsification.example_vi: Quản trị viên mạng đã gán một địa chỉ IP tĩnh cho từng máy chủ web.
falsification.why_distinct: No duplicate concept in canonical or prior tasks. Unique numerical host identifier on an IP network.

note: Sense: tangible memento or keepsake item. JMdict 1795360 s0 gloss souvenir, pri 0. Wiktionary line 5451 vi translation đồ lưu niệm. Replaced abstract 記念 with concrete 記念品 per review feedback.

en.sense_definition: A tangible object or memento purchased or kept to preserve the memory of a place visited or an event attended.

falsification.example_en: She purchased a small wooden keychain as a travel souvenir from the traditional craft market.
falsification.example_ja: 彼女は伝統工芸品市場で旅行の記念品として小さな木製のキーホルダーを購入した。
falsification.example_vi: Cô ấy đã mua một chiếc móc khóa bằng gỗ nhỏ làm đồ lưu niệm du lịch từ khu chợ thủ công truyền thống.
falsification.why_distinct: concept-lex-commemoration-nou-17479e denotes abstract commemoration or remembrance (記念); souvenir is the concrete physical memento object (記念品).
